# Local dependencies

Put these jars in this folder before building. They are not committed: some are other Gardens plugins, and some are third-party plugins whose licenses don't allow redistribution.

- `EnderMap-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`
- `EnderWardrobe-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar`
- `GardensCrops-1.0-SNAPSHOT-all.jar`
- `GardensEnchants-1.0-SNAPSHOT-all.jar`
- `GardensFurniture-1.0-SNAPSHOT-all.jar`
- `HuskHomes-api-4.9.9.jar`
- `ItemEdit-3.7.4.jar`
- `MCPets 4.1.6 (1.21.+).jar`
- `PlayerAuctions 1.33.0.jar`
